MERCHANT_ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 10 -- MERCHANT_ITEMS_PER_PAGE (ref MerchantFrame.lua l.1) BUYBACK_ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 12 -- BUYBACK_ITEMS_PER_PAGE (ref l.2; rows 11/12 are buyback-only)
-- The coin display, quoted from the real SmallMoneyFrame (ref MoneyFrame.xml/lua): a copper -- amount renders as a number + a 13px coin icon per NONZERO denomination, cut from the one -- shared texture Interface\MoneyFrame\UI-MoneyIcons by TexCoord (gold 0..0.25, silver -- 0.25..0.5, copper 0.5..0.75 — ref l.115/74/33), the real collapse that hides zero coins -- (MoneyFrame.lua l.221-267). Each money display owns three position-"slots"; the XML chains -- them either left-to-right (row prices + the quest reward: Coin1 leftmost, gold first) or -- right-to-left (the purses: Coin1 rightmost, copper first). BenillaMoney_Set fills the -- visible denominations into slots 1.. in DISPLAY order (highestFirst=true for the -- left-aligned chains) and — the real shrink, MoneyFrame.lua l.202/269 — sizes each slot to -- exactly its number + its 13px coin (`SetWidth(GetTextWidth() + iconWidth)` there; the -- same read here, off the number FontString the slot already owns). The static ±4px -- chain-anchor offsets are the real MONEY_BUTTON_SPACING gap, so a shrunk group packs tight, -- left-flush in the ltr chains and right-flush in the rtl ones. BenillaMoney_Clear hides -- all three slots (the real collapse hides, see the helper). -- -- NOTE (for the loot window's fold): the reusable helpers are -- BenillaMoney_Set(prefix, copper) and BenillaMoney_Clear(prefix) -- where `prefix` names the slot frames `<prefix>Coin1..3` (each with a `<prefix>CoinNIcon` -- texture + `<prefix>CoinNNum` fontstring child). They live in this file. BENILLA_COIN_TC = { { 0.0, 0.25 }, -- [1] gold { 0.25, 0.5 }, -- [2] silver { 0.5, 0.75 }, -- [3] copper }
-- Unused slots HIDE (the real collapse — MoneyFrame.lua l.230/247 goldButton:Hide()), never -- SetWidth(0): a 0 width means "derive from opposing anchors" to the layout (the client's -- own G+0x50 convention), not "zero px". Fills are contiguous from Coin1, so a chain never -- anchors THROUGH a hidden slot. function BenillaMoney_Clear(prefix) for i = 1, 3 do getglobal(prefix .. "Coin" .. i):Hide() end end
function BenillaMoney_Set(prefix, copper, highestFirst) copper = copper or 0 local vals = { math.floor(copper / 10000), -- gold math.floor((copper % 10000) / 100), -- silver copper % 100, -- copper } -- Fill slots 1.. in display order (see the module comment); a zero denomination is -- skipped (the real collapse), except copper always shows when the whole amount is -- zero so a free item / empty purse isn't blank. local first, last, step = 3, 1, -1 if highestFirst then first, last, step = 1, 3, 1 end local slot = 0 for d = first, last, step do if vals[d] > 0 or (d == 3 and vals[1] == 0 and vals[2] == 0) then slot = slot + 1 -- The real shrink: this slot is exactly its number + its 13px coin, and the -- XML anchor chain re-flows off the new width. -- Text first, then measure it: the engine answers a width read inside the -- tick that set the text, so the number IS this number and not the last one. local num = getglobal(prefix .. "Coin" .. slot .. "Num") num:SetText(vals[d]) local numW = num:GetStringWidth() local slotFrame = getglobal(prefix .. "Coin" .. slot) slotFrame:SetWidth(numW + 13) slotFrame:Show() local icon = getglobal(prefix .. "Coin" .. slot .. "Icon") icon:SetTexture("Interface\\MoneyFrame\\UI-MoneyIcons") icon:SetTexCoord(BENILLA_COIN_TC[d][1], BENILLA_COIN_TC[d][2], 0, 1) num:SetWidth(numW) end end for i = slot + 1, 3 do getglobal(prefix .. "Coin" .. i):Hide() end end
-- Recolor the coin *numbers* (the ref's SetMoneyFrameColor — the digits redden, the coin icons -- keep their own texture). The trainer detail cost calls this white when affordable / red -- (1.0, 0.1, 0.1) when not; a plain purse never calls it, so its coins stay default. Applies to -- all 3 slots (hidden ones are harmless) and must be re-called after each BenillaMoney_Set, -- which fills the numbers but does not reset their color. function BenillaMoney_SetColor(prefix, r, g, b) for i = 1, 3 do getglobal(prefix .. "Coin" .. i .. "Num"):SetTextColor(r, g, b) end end
-- ── The editable money-input kit (ref MoneyInputFrame.lua) ──────────────────────────────── -- A <prefix> naming three numeric EditBoxes <prefix>Gold/Silver/Copper — the shared money entry -- both the send-mail and trade windows inline (decision 0592 P2 builds it here, the money home, -- so both reuse it). GetCopper folds the three digits into a copper total; SetCopper splits a -- copper amount back across the boxes. SetCopper is a *programmatic* fill, so it must not re-fire -- a box's OnTextChanged value-changed callback (the loop the reference's `expectChanges` counter -- guards, MoneyInputFrame.lua l.44-73). Because benilla fires OnTextChanged synchronously inside -- SetText, a bracket flag is exact and simpler than the counter: a window's box calls -- BenillaMoneyInput_Consume(prefix) at the top of its OnTextChanged — false (swallow) while a -- SetCopper is in flight, true for a genuine keystroke. BENILLA_MONEYINPUT_SUPPRESS = {}
function BenillaMoneyInput_ResetMoney(prefix) getglobal(prefix .. "Gold"):SetText("") getglobal(prefix .. "Silver"):SetText("") getglobal(prefix .. "Copper"):SetText("") end
function BenillaMoneyInput_GetCopper(prefix) local function n(box) return tonumber(getglobal(prefix .. box):GetText()) or 0 end return n("Gold") * 10000 + n("Silver") * 100 + n("Copper") end
function BenillaMoneyInput_ClearFocus(prefix) getglobal(prefix .. "Gold"):ClearFocus() getglobal(prefix .. "Silver"):ClearFocus() getglobal(prefix .. "Copper"):ClearFocus() end
function BenillaMoneyInput_SetCopper(prefix, money) money = money or 0 local parts = { Gold = math.floor(money / 10000), Silver = math.floor((money % 10000) / 100), Copper = money % 100, } BENILLA_MONEYINPUT_SUPPRESS[prefix] = true for box, val in pairs(parts) do local eb = getglobal(prefix .. box) if (tonumber(eb:GetText()) or 0) ~= val then eb:SetText(val == 0 and "" or tostring(val)) end end BENILLA_MONEYINPUT_SUPPRESS[prefix] = false end
function BenillaMoneyInput_Consume(prefix) return not BENILLA_MONEYINPUT_SUPPRESS[prefix] end
function BenillaMerchantItem_OnLoad(button, index) button.merchantIndex = index local n = button:GetName() button.icon = getglobal(n .. "Icon") button.name = getglobal(n .. "Name") button.count = getglobal(n .. "Count") button.slot = getglobal(n .. "Slot") button.nameFrame = getglobal(n .. "NameFrame") -- The label-slot plate's resting dim (ref MerchantFrame.lua l.107/114 — 0.5 gray); -- every fill re-colors it through the sold-out/unusable legs in Row_Fill. button.nameFrame:SetVertexColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) -- Both buttons must reach OnClick: right-click buys, left-click is the (pending) drag-buy. -- The default click set is LeftButtonUp only. button:RegisterForClicks("LeftButtonUp", "RightButtonUp") end
-- The merchant-list index a row button shows on the current page (ref index arithmetic, -- MerchantFrame.lua l.74). function BenillaMerchantFrame_ItemIndex(button) return ((MerchantFrame.page or 1) - 1) * MERCHANT_ITEMS_PER_PAGE + button.merchantIndex end
function BenillaMerchantItem_OnClick(button, mouseButton) -- Buyback tab: either click buys the slot back (ref MerchantItemButton_OnClick's else -- arm, l.358-361) — and, as there, with NO modifier branch of any kind: 1.12 ships no -- GetBuybackItemLink, so a buyback row carries no link at all (ui_merchant.rs). if MerchantFrame.selectedTab == 2 then BuybackItem(button.merchantIndex) return end local index = BenillaMerchantFrame_ItemIndex(button) if mouseButton == "LeftButton" then -- The reference's LEFT-button modifier fork (ref l.301-306): CTRL previews the -- vendor's item in the dressing room (decision 1060) — which is what the Ctrl-hover -- magnifier this window already arms has been promising — and SHIFT posts its link -- into an open chat edit box (decision 1059). Both return: a modified click must -- never also buy. if IsControlKeyDown() then DressUpItemLink(GetMerchantItemLink(index)) return elseif IsShiftKeyDown() then -- ref l.304-306, through the shared helper (UIParent.xml): it carries the ref's -- own edit-box-visible guard AND our nil-link one (a row whose item template is -- still in flight has no link yet). BenillaChatEdit_InsertLink(GetMerchantItemLink(index)) -- DEFERRED, in the ref's own words: the `else` half of that shift arm is -- `local maxStack = GetMerchantItemMaxStack(this:GetID())` → -- `OpenStackSplitFrame(maxStack, ...)`, buying up to what you can afford -- (ref l.307-327). `GetMerchantItemMaxStack` has no binding here, so a -- shift-click with chat CLOSED does nothing rather than guess a max stack. return end -- Plain LEFT-click is PickupMerchantItem, a drag-buy onto the cursor (ref l.329) — -- still a no-op here until the cursor-item arc lands. elseif mouseButton == "RightButton" then -- The ref's right-button leg opens with `if IsControlKeyDown() ... then return` -- (l.332-333): a Ctrl-held right-click does nothing at all, and in particular must -- not buy while the player is Ctrl-clicking around to preview. Its shift arm is the -- same GetMerchantItemMaxStack stack-split deferred above (l.334-353) — and the -- ref's own `maxStack <= 1` case re-enters to buy a single unit (l.341-343), which -- is exactly what falling through to BuyMerchantItem does here. if IsControlKeyDown() then return end BuyMerchantItem(index) end end
-- Hover: the real item tooltip (GameTooltip:SetMerchantItem / SetBuybackItem by tab — -- ref ItemButton OnEnter l.63-86). The real client's tooltip owner is the row's 37px -- ItemButton at the row's TOPLEFT; ours is the whole 153px row, so ANCHOR_RIGHT walks its -- offset back to the icon's TOPRIGHT (37 − 153 = −116). No buy-price line — the price is -- on the row, and the real vendor tooltip doesn't repeat it. function BenillaMerchantItem_OnEnter(button) if MerchantFrame.selectedTab == 2 then if not GetBuybackItemInfo(button.merchantIndex) then return end GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_RIGHT", -116, 0) GameTooltip:SetBuybackItem(button.merchantIndex) GameTooltip:Show() -- Buyback tab: the coin arms directly (ref item OnEnter else-leg, -- ShowBuybackSellCursor l.84) — Buy if affordable, grayed UnableBuy if not. ShowBuybackSellCursor(button.merchantIndex) return end local index = BenillaMerchantFrame_ItemIndex(button) if not GetMerchantItemInfo(index) then return end GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_RIGHT", -116, 0) GameTooltip:SetMerchantItem(index) GameTooltip:Show() -- Buy tab: remember the row so the frame's OnUpdate arms the coin every frame — Buy -- vs the grayed UnableBuy by affordability, or the Inspect magnifier while Ctrl is held -- (ref MerchantFrame.itemHover + OnUpdate l.82/725-731). MerchantFrame.itemHover = index end
function BenillaMerchantItem_OnLeave(button) GameTooltip:Hide() -- Drop the coin/inspect override and stop the OnUpdate arming (ref OnLeave l.87-90). ResetCursor() MerchantFrame.itemHover = nil end
-- One row's item fill — the shape both pages share (ref fills name/texture/count/money -- identically in UpdateMerchantInfo l.78-118 and UpdateBuybackInfo l.219-260). -- soldOut/usable drive the ref's three coloring legs (l.87-110): a sold-out row grays -- whole (dark red 0.5,0,0 if ALSO unusable), an unusable row reds whole — the label -- plate + socket at full red, the icon at the ref's 0.9 — and the normal row is the -- white socket/icon over the 0.5 plate. function BenillaMerchantRow_Fill(button, name, texture, price, quantity, soldOut, usable) local prefix = button:GetName() .. "Price" if name ~= nil or texture ~= nil then -- name is nil while the item-template query is in flight; the icon comes straight -- from the wire display_id, so it's there immediately. button.icon:SetTexture(texture or BENILLA_FALLBACK_ICON) button.name:SetText(name or "...") BenillaMoney_Set(prefix, price, true) -- left-aligned: gold first -- Buy-stack count only when a purchase delivers more than one — the bare number, -- exactly like a bag slot (the real SetItemButtonCount; no "x" prefix). if (quantity or 1) > 1 then button.count:SetText(quantity) else button.count:SetText("") end if soldOut then if not usable then button.nameFrame:SetVertexColor(0.5, 0, 0) -- ref l.90-93 button.slot:SetVertexColor(0.5, 0, 0) button.icon:SetVertexColor(0.5, 0, 0) else button.nameFrame:SetVertexColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) -- ref l.95-98 button.slot:SetVertexColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) button.icon:SetVertexColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) end elseif not usable then button.nameFrame:SetVertexColor(1.0, 0, 0) -- ref l.102-105 button.slot:SetVertexColor(1.0, 0, 0) button.icon:SetVertexColor(0.9, 0, 0) else button.nameFrame:SetVertexColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) -- ref l.107-110 button.slot:SetVertexColor(1, 1, 1) button.icon:SetVertexColor(1, 1, 1) end else -- Empty slot: clear the item, blank the price coins, dim the socket to 0.4 and -- rest the plate at 0.5 (ref MerchantFrame.lua l.112-118). button.icon:SetTexture(nil) button.name:SetText("") button.count:SetText("") BenillaMoney_Clear(prefix) button.nameFrame:SetVertexColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) button.slot:SetVertexColor(0.4, 0.4, 0.4) end end
-- The merchant page (ref MerchantFrame_UpdateMerchantInfo l.66-193): the paged 10 rows, -- the repair pair, the single most-recent buyback slot, the page buttons, the merchant -- bottom border — and the buyback page's pieces hidden. function MerchantFrame_UpdateMerchantInfo() local frame = MerchantFrame local page = frame.page or 1 local numItems = GetMerchantNumItems()
for i = 1, MERCHANT_ITEMS_PER_PAGE do local button = getglobal("MerchantItem" .. i) local index = (page - 1) * MERCHANT_ITEMS_PER_PAGE + i if index <= numItems then local name, texture, price, quantity, numAvailable, isUsable = GetMerchantItemInfo(index) BenillaMerchantRow_Fill(button, name, texture, price, quantity, numAvailable == 0, isUsable) else BenillaMerchantRow_Fill(button, nil, nil, 0, 0) end end
-- Rows back to the merchant spacing (ref l.188-192; the buyback page spreads them to -- -15). SetPoint replaces the same-point anchor, the real client's semantics. getglobal("MerchantItem3"):SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal("MerchantItem1"), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -8) getglobal("MerchantItem5"):SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal("MerchantItem3"), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -8) getglobal("MerchantItem7"):SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal("MerchantItem5"), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -8) getglobal("MerchantItem9"):SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal("MerchantItem7"), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -8)
-- Buyback-page-only pieces off (ref l.180-186), merchant-only pieces on (ref l.175-178). getglobal("MerchantItem11"):Hide() getglobal("MerchantItem12"):Hide() getglobal("BuybackFrameTopLeft"):Hide() getglobal("BuybackFrameTopRight"):Hide() getglobal("BuybackFrameBotLeft"):Hide() getglobal("BuybackFrameBotRight"):Hide() getglobal("MerchantFrameBottomLeftBorder"):Show() getglobal("MerchantFrameBottomRightBorder"):Show()
-- The repair pair shows iff this vendor repairs (ref l.121-130); the all-button -- enables iff there is damage to pay for (ref MerchantFrame_OnShow l.37-46 — our -- vertex-color gray stands in for its SetDesaturation, which the engine lacks). if CanMerchantRepair() then getglobal("MerchantRepairText"):Show() local allButton = getglobal("MerchantRepairAllButton") local itemButton = getglobal("MerchantRepairItemButton") allButton:Show() itemButton:Show() local repairAllCost, canRepair = GetRepairAllCost() local icon = getglobal("MerchantRepairAllIcon") if canRepair then icon:SetVertexColor(1, 1, 1) allButton:Enable() else icon:SetVertexColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) allButton:Disable() end else getglobal("MerchantRepairText"):Hide() getglobal("MerchantRepairAllButton"):Hide() getglobal("MerchantRepairItemButton"):Hide() end
-- The single buyback slot: the MOST RECENT sale (ref l.132-152 — -- GetBuybackItemInfo(GetNumBuybackItems())). local slot = getglobal("MerchantBuyBackItem") local bbName, bbTexture, bbPrice, bbQuantity = GetBuybackItemInfo(GetNumBuybackItems()) if bbName then slot.icon:SetTexture(bbTexture or BENILLA_FALLBACK_ICON) slot.name:SetText(bbName) if (bbQuantity or 1) > 1 then slot.count:SetText(bbQuantity) else slot.count:SetText("") end BenillaMoney_Set("MerchantBuyBackItemPrice", bbPrice, true) slot.slot:SetVertexColor(1, 1, 1) else slot.icon:SetTexture(nil) slot.name:SetText("") slot.count:SetText("") BenillaMoney_Clear("MerchantBuyBackItemPrice") slot.slot:SetVertexColor(0.4, 0.4, 0.4) -- Hide the tooltip upon sale of the last slot (ref l.148-151). if GameTooltip:IsOwned(slot) then GameTooltip:Hide() end end slot:Show()
-- Paging (ref l.154-173): buttons + label only when the stock overflows one page. local prevButton = getglobal("MerchantPrevPageButton") local nextButton = getglobal("MerchantNextPageButton") local pageText = getglobal("MerchantPageText") if numItems > MERCHANT_ITEMS_PER_PAGE then pageText:SetText(string.format("Page %d", page)) -- PAGE_NUMBER if page == 1 then prevButton:Disable() else prevButton:Enable() end if page >= math.ceil(numItems / MERCHANT_ITEMS_PER_PAGE) then nextButton:Disable() else nextButton:Enable() end pageText:Show() prevButton:Show() nextButton:Show() else pageText:Hide() prevButton:Hide() nextButton:Hide() end
-- Title + portrait back to the vendor (ref l.67-68): re-bind the "npc" model bake the -- buyback page's raw SetTexture(UI-BuyBack-Icon) dropped. BenillaMerchantFrame_SetTitle(frame.vendorName) SetPortraitTexture(getglobal("MerchantFramePortrait"), "npc") end
-- The buyback page (ref MerchantFrame_UpdateBuybackInfo l.195-273): 12 rows over the -- buyback slots, the wider -15 row spacing, the buyback corner art — and every -- merchant-only piece hidden. function MerchantFrame_UpdateBuybackInfo() getglobal("MerchantNameText"):SetText("Merchant Buyback") -- MERCHANT_BUYBACK -- The buyback icon is drawn for the portrait ring — the ref sets it RAW (SetTexture, -- l.197), not through the portrait mask. getglobal("MerchantFramePortrait"):SetTexture("Interface\\MerchantFrame\\UI-BuyBack-Icon")
getglobal("MerchantItem11"):Show() getglobal("MerchantItem12"):Show() getglobal("BuybackFrameTopLeft"):Show() getglobal("BuybackFrameTopRight"):Show() getglobal("BuybackFrameBotLeft"):Show() getglobal("BuybackFrameBotRight"):Show()
-- The wider buyback row spacing (ref l.208-211). getglobal("MerchantItem3"):SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal("MerchantItem1"), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -15) getglobal("MerchantItem5"):SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal("MerchantItem3"), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -15) getglobal("MerchantItem7"):SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal("MerchantItem5"), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -15) getglobal("MerchantItem9"):SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal("MerchantItem7"), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -15)
local numBuyback = GetNumBuybackItems() for i = 1, BUYBACK_ITEMS_PER_PAGE do local button = getglobal("MerchantItem" .. i) if i <= numBuyback then local name, texture, price, quantity, numAvailable, isUsable = GetBuybackItemInfo(i) -- Never soldOut here: the ref's buyback sold-out leg tests its merchant-page -- variable (undefined on this path) and so never fires — buyback rows only -- red on unusable, they never gray. BenillaMerchantRow_Fill(button, name, texture, price, quantity, false, isUsable) else BenillaMerchantRow_Fill(button, nil, nil, 0, 0) end end
-- Merchant-only pieces off (ref l.263-272). getglobal("MerchantRepairText"):Hide() getglobal("MerchantRepairAllButton"):Hide() getglobal("MerchantRepairItemButton"):Hide() getglobal("MerchantBuyBackItem"):Hide() getglobal("MerchantPrevPageButton"):Hide() getglobal("MerchantNextPageButton"):Hide() getglobal("MerchantPageText"):Hide() getglobal("MerchantFrameBottomLeftBorder"):Hide() getglobal("MerchantFrameBottomRightBorder"):Hide() end
function MerchantFrame_Update() -- The tab dispatch (ref MerchantFrame_Update l.57-64) + the purse (the ref's money -- frame updates itself on PLAYER_MONEY; ours repaints with the window). if MerchantFrame.selectedTab == 2 then MerchantFrame_UpdateBuybackInfo() else MerchantFrame_UpdateMerchantInfo() end BenillaMoney_Set("MerchantMoney", GetMoney()) end
-- The tab pair (ref MerchantFrameTab1/2 OnClick l.682-685/704-707): select + repaint. function BenillaMerchantFrameTab_OnClick(id) PanelTemplates_SetTab(MerchantFrame, id) MerchantFrame_Update() end
-- Paging clicks (ref MerchantPrevPageButton_OnClick/Next l.275-285). function MerchantPrevPageButton_OnClick() PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") MerchantFrame.page = (MerchantFrame.page or 1) - 1 MerchantFrame_Update() end
function MerchantNextPageButton_OnClick() PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") MerchantFrame.page = (MerchantFrame.page or 1) + 1 MerchantFrame_Update() end
-- The single buyback slot's handlers (ref MerchantBuyBackItemItemButton l.516-541): a -- click buys back the most recent sale; the hover shows its tooltip. function BenillaMerchantBuyBackItem_OnClick() BuybackItem(GetNumBuybackItems()) end
function BenillaMerchantBuyBackItem_OnEnter(button) if not GetBuybackItemInfo(GetNumBuybackItems()) then return end GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_RIGHT", -116, 0) GameTooltip:SetBuybackItem(GetNumBuybackItems()) GameTooltip:Show() ShowBuybackSellCursor(GetNumBuybackItems()) end
-- The repair pair (ref MerchantRepairAllButton/MerchantRepairItemButton l.381-459). -- The repair-all tooltip's embedded money line ships (SetTooltipMoney over the shared -- coin kit — its OnEnter above); repair-mode clicks route through InRepairMode -- (decisions 0138/0139). function BenillaMerchantRepairAllButton_OnClick() RepairAllItems() PlaySound("ITEM_REPAIR") GameTooltip:Hide() end
function BenillaMerchantRepairItemButton_OnClick() if InRepairMode() then HideRepairCursor() else ShowRepairCursor() end end
function MerchantFrame_OnLoad() local frame = this -- The NPC portrait: the "npc" unit token → the vendor's live model bake -- (crates/benilla/src/portrait, InteractNpc). The buyback page overrides this ring with a -- raw SetTexture (which drops the binding); the vendor page restores it (see below). SetPortraitTexture(getglobal(frame:GetName() .. "Portrait"), "npc") frame:RegisterEvent("MERCHANT_SHOW") frame:RegisterEvent("MERCHANT_UPDATE") frame:RegisterEvent("MERCHANT_CLOSED") -- The purse repaints on the real coinage event (the SmallMoneyFrame's own OnEvent in -- the real client) — a sell changes money without a MERCHANT_UPDATE. frame:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_MONEY") -- The tab pair + first page (ref MerchantFrame_OnLoad l.9-12; children's OnLoads have -- already fired — bottom-up, rf26 — so the tabs exist to select). frame.page = 1 PanelTemplates_SetNumTabs(frame, 2) PanelTemplates_SetTab(frame, 1) end
-- The vendor name arrives as arg1 of MERCHANT_SHOW/MERCHANT_UPDATE (the app resolves the -- vendor guid through the NameCache); nil/empty until it lands → the "Merchant" fallback. function BenillaMerchantFrame_SetTitle(name) if name == nil or name == "" then name = "Merchant" end getglobal("MerchantNameText"):SetText(name) end
function MerchantFrame_OnEvent() local frame = this if event == "PLAYER_MONEY" then BenillaMoney_Set("MerchantMoney", GetMoney()) elseif event == "MERCHANT_SHOW" then -- Fresh session: first page, merchant tab (ref OnEvent l.29 / OnShow l.47). frame.page = 1 frame.vendorName = arg1 PanelTemplates_SetTab(frame, 1) BenillaMerchantFrame_SetTitle(arg1) MerchantFrame_Update() ShowUIPanel(frame) elseif event == "MERCHANT_UPDATE" then frame.vendorName = arg1 if frame.selectedTab ~= 2 then BenillaMerchantFrame_SetTitle(arg1) end MerchantFrame_Update() elseif event == "MERCHANT_CLOSED" then HideUIPanel(frame) end end
function BenillaMerchantCloseButton_OnClick() -- vanilla's client-side close sends no packet; the app clears the merchant on this intent -- (which fires MERCHANT_CLOSED), and we hide immediately so there's no one-frame lag. CloseMerchant() HideUIPanel(getglobal("MerchantFrame")) end

Scripts.OnEnter: GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText("Repair All Items") local repairAllCost, canRepair = GetRepairAllCost() if canRepair and repairAllCost > 0 then SetTooltipMoney(GameTooltip, repairAllCost) end GameTooltip:Show()

Scripts.OnLoad: local n = self:GetName() self.icon = getglobal(n .. "Icon") self.name = getglobal(n .. "Name") self.count = getglobal(n .. "Count") self.slot = getglobal(n .. "Slot") getglobal(n .. "NameFrame"):SetVertexColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)

Scripts.OnUpdate: if MerchantFrame.itemHover then if IsControlKeyDown() then ShowInspectCursor() else ShowMerchantSellCursor(MerchantFrame.itemHover) end end
Scripts.OnHide: CloseMerchant(); CloseBackpack(); HideRepairCursor(); ResetCursor(); MerchantFrame.itemHover = nil; PlaySound("igCharacterInfoClose")
